description: This file defines the JsonObjectBuilder interface, which provides methods for building and manipulating JSON objects in Java. It includes methods for setting, removing, and building JSON fields with support for predicates and various data types.

classes.name: JsonObjectBuilder
classes.description: An interface for a mutable builder that constructs JsonObject instances, supporting method chaining, conditional field setting, and field removal.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a field with a specific data type (int, long, double, boolean, String, JsonValue) in the JSON object being built, optionally conditioned on a predicate.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple fields from an iterable collection of JsonField objects, with optional predicate filtering.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a field by key or by JsonFieldDefinition from the JSON object being built.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates and returns a new JsonObject containing all the fields added to the builder.
